note: Frozen final_validation set for comparing the direct quote-decision-v1 architecture with hybrid quote-extract-v2 plus Python rules. These sentences were not used to write either prompt. Expected decisions were written by hand from the fictional catalog and the published policies, not by printing correct_decision. The proposed field copies that expected decision so the file loads. It is not a model output and it is not shown to the model. Expressions the reader leaves unresolved, such as '2 by 4 by 8' without a foot unit, bare '4×8' with no plywood word and no foot unit, and '4×8 inches', are not in this file because assigning a length or a sheet size would be a guess. final-ambiguous-eight has two readings: two catalog rows share the specs, and the 8-foot primary is also out of stock when substitution is not allowed. Both readings require human review with no SKU, so the scored fields are not forced past that agreement.
